newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec leading index 70.0, coincident 90.0.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec leading index 70.0, coincident 90.0.

text.p: Japan's diffusion index of leading economic indicators stood at 70.0 on a scale of 100 in December, staying above the so-called "boom or bust" mark of 50 for a fourth consecutive month, the Economic Planning Agency said on Friday.
A breakdown of the indices of economic indicators follows:
The EPA said in statement that the data showed Japan's economy was continuing to recover.
It was the fourth month in a row in which both the leading and coincident indices had been above 50, the EPA said.
A figure for the leading index above 50 is generally taken as suggesting the economy will expand in the coming months, while a number below 50 suggests the economy will contract.
The coincident index measures current economic conditions, while the lagging index traces economic trends in the past few months.
